description: Search the JSONPad documentation, the JavaScript SDK references and the command line tool reference. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet and their jsonpad.io URL; read one with read_doc. Exact identifiers work well: error codes and names, headers, SDK methods, CLI commands, $jsonpad-var variables, "POST /lists/{listId}/items".

section.description: Only search one section: guides, api-reference (every API reference section), lists, items, indexes, identities, tokens, flows, schema-sync, sdk or cli

name: search_docs
title: Search the JSONPad docs
